steps.note: THE BOARD VANISHED. Not an update, not a hand-back -- unplugged, rebooted, off the WiFi. In board mode this page keeps no store of its own by design, so the sweep's unshipped work lives only in this tab, and this is the one disconnect that has to say so. The DETECTION (worker.js counts SYNC_GIVE_UP failed posts) is pinned in the host suite; what only a browser can show is that the panel a person reads actually appears, carries the warning, and is styled as the bad case.
Nothing is wrong yet, so nothing may be showing. A panel that is visible before anything went wrong is the cry-wolf failure, and it would pass every check below.
